propositions: Bridge scheduling transitioned from continuous self-re-dispatch to cron-only execution after RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS was set to false; the cron schedule must be updated from a three-entry 40-minute workaround to a single hourly entry.

CloudWatch alarm bridge_run_failures is structurally unfirable at hourly cadence (at most one pass per hour) and must be retuned from threshold=1/evaluation_periods=1 to threshold=0/evaluation_periods=2/datapoints_to_alarm=2 to detect sustained failures while remaining silent on single flakes.

Cadence test must be retargeted to derive fire times from the workflow cron, assert uniform 60-minute gaps, verify exactly one schedule entry, and enforce a non-zero minute offset from :00 to avoid GitHub's contended top-of-hour slot.

Documentation and alert messaging must be updated from 40-minute cadence references to hourly, with worst-case sync latency revised to 1 hour; the 2-hourly canary remains unchanged with its 4-hour window still valid under the new 3-hour floor.
Terraform apply is required to deploy the rettuned CloudWatch alarm and clear the Terraform Drift gate; until applied, the deployed alarm remains at the old tuning and bridge failures are unalarmed.
